name: Grove TMG3993 light, colour, proximity & gesture sensor
description: ams TMG39931: an IR-LED proximity sensor (8-bit count), clear/red/green/blue ambient light channels (16-bit counts each) and a gesture engine, over I2C at the fixed address 0x39. The chip runs on 2.4-3.6 V; the Grove board adds a 3.0 V regulator (XC6206), 2N7002 I2C level shifters with 4.7 kOhm pull-ups to VCC and a boost/buck supply for the IR LED, so the module runs on 3.3-5 V. Sold as: Seeed Studio Grove - Light & Gesture & Color & Proximity Sensor (TMG39931), SKU 101020580, 4-pin Grove connector SCL, SDA, VCC, GND.
eli5: Shines invisible light to tell how close your hand is, and measures how much red, green and blue light falls on it.

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (Grove pin 1, yellow wire); level shifted, 4.7 kOhm pull-up to VCC on the board

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (Grove pin 2, white wire); level shifted, 4.7 kOhm pull-up to VCC on the board

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Supply (Grove pin 3, red wire), 3.3-5 V. Use 3.3 V with an ESP32/Pico: the I2C pull-ups go to VCC

supplierQuery: Seeed Grove Light Gesture Color Proximity Sensor TMG39931
buildNotes: Power VCC from 3.3 V when using an ESP32, Pico or Raspberry Pi: the board's 4.7 kOhm I2C pull-ups go to VCC, so a 5 V supply would put 5 V on SDA/SCL.
The address 0x39 is fixed (TMG39931): only one sensor per I2C bus. The APDS-9960 uses the same address.
Check the ID register 0x92: bits 7:2 read 101010 (0x2A), so the byte is 0xA8 on this VDD-bus version.

Write all control registers with ENABLE = 0, then set PON, wait about 6 ms (exit-sleep pause), then ENABLE = 0x07 (PON + AEN + PEN). CONFIG1 0x8D reserved bits 6:5 must stay 1 (0x60) and CONFIG2 0x90 bit 0 must stay 1.
Colour integration = 2.78 ms x (256 - ATIME); max count = min(65535, 1024 x (256 - ATIME) + 1). Wait for STATUS AVALID, then read 8 bytes from 0x94: clear, red, green, blue, each low byte first.
Proximity: wait for STATUS PVALID, then read PDATA (0x9C), 0-255, higher = closer.
The interrupt pin is only on a solder pad (J1), not on the Grove connector. Gesture detection (FIFO 0xFC-0xFF) is not covered by this driver or the simulator.

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from tmg3993 import TMG3993

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = TMG3993(i2c)
while True:
    p = sensor.proximity()
    c, r, g, b = sensor.color_raw()
    print('P=%d C=%d R=%d G=%d B=%d' % (p, c, r, g, b))
    time.sleep(1)

test.title: Reports the proximity and the clear, red, green and blue counts set on the sliders
